derived_results.claim: The exact r99 128x128 sign-safe C_tt lower-envelope formula was evaluated over all 256 established 16x16 Gaussian null-parameter cells. All 256 are positive in binary64; the unique global minimum is cell (mu=0..h/16, top log-sigma cell) at 0.3901934960354582, exactly the same cell already directed-positive in r99.

A separate numpy longdouble implementation of the complete 256-cell map remains positive with the same global minimum 0.3901934960354769. Maximum absolute binary64-vs-longdouble discrepancy anywhere in the map is 9.237055564881302e-14, many orders below the 0.39019 minimum margin.

Recomputing the complete engineering map at the converged r99 rho root 0.5544128274647656 keeps all cells positive and increases the worst-cell lower-envelope margin to 0.3902690349627233; the largest absolute map change is about 0.00038802.

Let A/B be the symmetric low/high-variance corner-pair averages and p_rho=rho A+(1-rho)B. For C_L=E_q[A/p_rho], C_H=E_q[B/p_rho], D=C_L-C_H, one has rho C_L+(1-rho)C_H=1 and D'(rho)=-E_q[(A-B)^2/p_rho^2]<0. Hence a certified D(rho)=0 root is unique and forces C_L=C_H=1. Even symmetry of q and p_rho then makes each +/- corner expectation equal to its pair average, so the four active-corner equalities require no four separate integrations once the scalar root is certified.
